name: Threat Model (STRIDE)
description: Structured STRIDE threat modeling at design time, before code exists: name assets, actors, and trust boundaries, walk Spoofing/Tampering/Repudiation/Information disclosure/Denial of service/Elevation of privilege at each boundary, rate and prioritize, and turn mitigations into build tasks. Use when designing a system, feature, or API or asking what could go wrong. Defensive only.
verification_requirements: every accepted threat has a mitigation, acceptance, or transfer decision
top mitigations converted into concrete build tasks
